introHtml: Snugz business cards offer a unique combination of durability and style, perfect for professionals who want their contact information to last. Unlike standard paper cards, these are printed on a tear-resistant material that withstands wallet wear and moisture. Ideal for marketing directors and sales teams handing out cards at trade shows or client meetings, Snugz cards make a memorable impression. Choose from a range of finishes and customize with your logo using full-color or foil stamping.
